```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(cowplot)
})
source("../functions.R")
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
load("../03_simulation1/simulated.lfcRes.RData")
st1 <- st
load("../02_MSdata/lfc_res.rds")
stLFC <- mergeSts(st1, st)
stLFC <- stLFC[stLFC$score=="padj.PAS.LSL.loc",]
stLFC$score <- "bbhw PA-shrunkLFC (gBH.LSL)"

load("plotDat.RData", verbose=TRUE)
stSig <- mergeSts(sts, st)
stSig <- stSig[stSig$score %in% c("padj.PAS.LSL.loc","FDR"),]
stSig$score <- gsub("padj.+","bbhw PAS (gBH.LSL)", stSig$score)
stSig$score <- gsub("FDR","standard (no prior)", stSig$score)
st <- rbind(stSig, stLFC)

tpr <- tprPlot(st) + scale_color_manual(values=setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, "Dark2"),unique(st$score)))
```


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
pdf("Figure6_logFC.pdf", width=10, height=5)
tpr
dev.off()
```
